Class ShipBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.shipBuilding.ShipBoard
Direct Known Subclasses:
SecondShipBoard, TestShipBoard
public abstract class ShipBoard extends Object
Abstract class representing a ship board in the game.

    • offerComponent

      public void offerComponent(Component component)
      Offers a component to the player (represented by the ShipBoard), so that it has exclusive control over it (i.e., he holds it in his hand).
      Parameters:
      component - The component to offer.

    • rejectComponent

      public Component rejectComponent()
      Rejects the last offered component, returning it to the component bank.
      Returns:
      The rejected component.

    • placeComponent

      public void placeComponent(Point newPosition, Direction orientation)
      Places the last offered component at a specific position and orientation on the ship board.
      Parameters:
      newPosition - The position where the component should be placed.
      orientation - The orientation of the component.

    • stashComponent

      public void stashComponent()
      Stashes the last placed component, making it available for later retrieval, if the specific ship board supports stashing.

    • grabStashedComponent

      public void grabStashedComponent(int index)
      Grabs a stashed component by its index, making it available for placement, if the specific ship board supports stashing.
      Parameters:
      index - The index of the stashed component to grab.

    • grabPlacedComponent

      public void grabPlacedComponent()
      Grabs the last placed component, making it available for placement. This method is called when the player decides to place a component that was previously placed.

    • weldLastComponent

      public void weldLastComponent()
      Welds the last placed component to the ship board at its current position. This method finalizes the placement of the component.

    • discardComponent

      public void discardComponent(Point position)
      Discards the last placed component, removing it from the ship board and notifying the event listener. This method is called when the player decides to discard a component instead of placing it.
      Parameters:
      position - The position of the component to discard.

    • removeComponent

      public void removeComponent(Point position)
      Removes a component from the ship board at a specific position and notifies the event listener. This method is called when the player decides to remove a component from the ship board during ship building.
      Parameters:
      position - The position of the component to remove.

    • finishBuilding

      public void finishBuilding()
      Finalizes the ship building process by welding the last component if it exists. This method is called when the player has finished placing components on the ship board.

    • getExposedConnectorsNumber

      public int getExposedConnectorsNumber()
      Calculates the number of exposed connectors on the ship board.

      the number of exposed connectors, which are connectors that are not connected to any other component.

    • getShieldDirections

      public Set<Direction> getShieldDirections()

    • getCenter

      public Point getCenter()

      the center point of the ship board, which is a fixed point at (7, 7).

    • activateComponent

      public boolean activateComponent(Point position)
      Activates a component at a specific position if it is not already active. This method checks if the activatable exists and activates it, notifying the event listener.
      Parameters:
      position - The position of the component to activate.
      Returns:
      true if the component was successfully activated, false if it was already active.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if there is no activatable for the specified position.

    • deactivateComponent

      public void deactivateComponent(Point position)

      Parameters:
      position - The position of the component to deactivate.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if there is no activatable for the specified position,

    • deactivateAll

      public void deactivateAll()
      Deactivates all active components on the ship board. This method iterates through all activatables and deactivates them if they are active.

    • checkValidity

      public boolean checkValidity()
      Checks the validity of the ship board. This method verifies that all components are correctly connected and that cannons and engines are valid.
      Returns:
      true if the ship board is valid, false otherwise.
